specDifferences.source: Chart(type: "bar" | "line" | "area" | "pie" | "donut" | "scatter", data: Record<string, string | number>[], x?: string, series?: string[], format?: "number" | "currency" | "percent", currency?: string, stacked?: boolean, height?: number)
specDifferences.kit: Chart(type: "bar" | "line" | "area" | "pie" | "donut" | "scatter", data: Record<string, string | number>[], x?: string, series?: string[], format?: "number" | "percent", stacked?: boolean, height?: number)

specDifferences.source: Rows of data; x is the category key (a number key for scatter), series the value keys (default: every number key). percent values are like 45; currency is a code like "EUR".
specDifferences.kit: Rows of data; x is the category key (a number key for scatter), series the value keys (default: every number key). format applies to pie and donut only: "percent" shows each slice as a share of the total, "number" its value. stacked stacks bar and area series. height sets the plot height in px; pie and donut ignore it and size themselves.

specDifferences.source: A place on a Map; icon is one emoji, else the pin shows its number.
specDifferences.kit: A place on a Map; icon is one emoji, else the pin shows its number. category groups markers under a filter on the map.
fill defaults to the text color; with only a stroke it stays unfilled.
fill defaults to the text color; with only a stroke it stays unfilled.
rx rounds the corners; fill defaults to the text color, and with only a stroke it stays unfilled.
Stroked in the text color, 2 wide, unless stroke and strokeWidth are set.
d is SVG path data only (M, L, C, A, Z...), else nothing draws; unfilled unless fill is set.
Closed shape; points like "0,0 10,5 20,0". fill defaults to the text color; with only a stroke it stays unfilled.

specDifferences.source: Group; transform like "rotate(30 50 50)" or "translate(10 0)".

A text label at x, y; anchor sets which end sits on x.

specDifferences.source: A date as text: "date" Oct 9, 2026 (default), "short" Oct 9, "long" Friday, October 9, 2026, "weekday" Fri, "month" Oct 2026, "time" 9:30 PM, "datetime", "iso" 2026-10-09. Dates are "YYYY-MM-DD", ISO or a timestamp
specDifferences.kit: A date as text: "date" Oct 9, 2026 (default), "short" Oct 9, "long" Friday, October 9, 2026, "weekday" Fri, "month" Oct 2026, "time" 9:30 PM, "datetime", "iso" 2026-10-09. Dates are "YYYY-MM-DD", ISO or a timestamp; "time" and "datetime" need a timestamp or an ISO date-time, as a plain date has no time
